Description

Amazono's Order Fulfillment Services team builds the systems that decide where, when and how every customer order is picked, packed and shipped. Every day we process hundreds of millions of events and our software has a direct effect on delivery speed for customers worldwide.

As an SDE II you will own the design and delivery of significant services, working with a small team of engineers and a product manager. You will be expected to dive deep, take ownership and deliver results, and to raise the bar for the engineers around you.
Key job responsibilities
Design and build highly available, low-latency services on AWS
Own operational excellence for your team's services, including on-call and root cause analysis
Write well-tested, maintainable code in Java and contribute to design and code reviews
Work with business and operations stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs
Mentor SDE I engineers and interns

A day in the life You will start your day by reviewing dashboards and tickets, then join a standup. Most of your time is spent designing, coding and reviewing, with some time on-call. We value work-life harmony and flexible schedules.
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases and distributed systems
Knowledge of professional software engineering best practices

Amazono is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazono is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. If you would like to request an accommodation, please visit the accommodations page.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $129,300/year in our lowest geographic market up to $223,600/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Amazono is a total compensation company. Dependent on the position offered, equity, sign-on payments, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Stripeo builds economic infrastructure for the internet. Businesses of every size, from new startups to public companies, use our software to accept payments, send payouts and manage their businesses online. We move trillions of dollars a year and care a great deal about correctness.

10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time leading technical projects.
Deep experience designing and operating high-throughput transactional systems with strong consistency requirements.
Strong command of at least one of Ruby, Java or Go, and comfort reading code in the others.
Expert knowledge of relational databases, including schema design, indexing and online migrations.
A track record of influencing without authority and of writing clearly.
**Nice to haves**
Experience with financial systems, double-entry ledgers or payments networks.
Familiarity with Kafka or other event streaming platforms.
Prior experience as a tech lead or staff engineer.
**Pay and benefits**

The annual salary range for this role is $212,000 - $318,000 USD for US-based candidates. Salary is based on location and level; this role is also eligible for equity and benefits. We offer a home-office stipend, wellness benefits and 401(k) matching.
**Hiring process**
Our process includes a recruiter conversation, a technical screen with an engineer, and a virtual onsite of four interviews. Please let us know if you need accommodations at any stage.

Retoolo - Senior Backend Engineer (Python)

Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
San Francisco, CA or Remote (US)
[Apply](https://retoolo.example.com/jobs/3495030/apply)

Retoolo is the fastest way to build internal software. Thousands of companies use us to build admin panels, dashboards and workflows on top of their own databases, and we're a small team where one engineer's work reaches a lot of users. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who loves Python and Postgres to join our Data Connectors team. Our backend is Python and FastAPI with PostgreSQL, Redis and Celery, deployed on AWS with Docker. You'll build the layer that securely connects our product to customers' databases and APIs, which means thinking a lot about performance, multi-tenancy, permissions and failure modes. Day to day you'll design new connector types, write the async workers that execute queries on behalf of users, tune slow SQL, and mentor two or three engineers on the team. We care about developer experience internally, so you'll also have time to improve our local environment and test suite. You don't need to have used our product, but you should be curious about how people build internal tools. We look for at least 5 years of backend experience, strong Python, deep PostgreSQL knowledge and comfort owning a service from design through on-call. Experience with Kubernetes is not needed, since our platform team handles that. Bonus points for experience with query planners, connection pooling or building multi-tenant systems. We pay $185k-$230k plus meaningful equity, cover health, dental and vision in full, and give every new hire a $3,000 setup budget. We're an equal opportunity employer and we'd love to hear from you even if you don't tick every box.

Supabaso is the open source Postgres development platform. We give every developer a production-grade database, authentication, storage and realtime in minutes. We're a fully remote team of about 90 people, serving more than a million developers.
The role

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to help us keep millions of Postgres databases fast and available. You'll work across our fleet management, observability and incident response, and you'll have a real say in how we run our infrastructure.
What you'll be doing
Operate and improve the platform that provisions, upgrades and backs up customer Postgres databases on AWS.
Build and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform and Kubernetes manifests.
Improve our observability stack and define SLOs with the engineering teams that own each service.
Lead incident response, write postmortems, and drive the follow-up work to completion.
Automate away toil, from capacity planning to certificate rotation.
Be on call in a follow-the-sun rotation with the rest of the team.
What we're looking for
5+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure engineering roles.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of PostgreSQL operations: replication, backups, vacuum, connection pooling.
Production experience with Kubernetes and a major cloud provider (AWS preferred).
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Go, Python or Rust.
Strong written communication. We are remote and async by default.
It would be a bonus if you
Have contributed to Postgres or related open source projects.
